terra.problem: The dream says the sheaves gather and bow, but does not say they stay in place afterward.
The text says Joseph’s father kept what he said in mind, not that the dreams stayed on everybody’s mind.
Reuben being Jacob’s oldest son is a fact from outside the passage, but the cited verse does not establish it. It needs a reference such as Genesis 35:23.
The claim that Reuben did not have long adds a time constraint the text does not give.
The passage does not establish the caravan’s route or say how far Nineveh was from it.
Saying he is not going to joke about the scene comments on how he tells the passage.
“Not yet” implies Reuben later went to tell his father, which this passage does not say.
It states why the brothers sent the robe as a fact, though the passage does not give their reason.
Jacob declares that Joseph has surely been torn to pieces; the text does not say he fears this has happened.
The explanation says the text does not say more, but the verse goes on to say that Joseph’s father wept for him.
The passage says Joseph was sold to Potiphar, but does not say he went to Potiphar’s house or call Potiphar a stranger to him.
